caption: People living in extreme poverty (below $2.15 a day) by country, 1990-2011, in millions. The window stops at 2011: after it, India (no survey until 2021) and China drop out of the data, which would misleadingly suggest poverty had ended. Computed as poverty rate (%) x population; between-survey years are interpolated. Source: World Bank PIP, via Open Data (CC BY 4.0).
